QuestInfo.name: Capturing the Thief
QuestInfo.0: Athena Pierce contacts you. She knows who took the jewel!
QuestInfo.1: Go to Ereve and capture Olive, per Athena Pierce's orders! \r\nYou'll find Olive towards the right of Ereve, in #m130030006#.

0.0: Greetings, #h0#. I've uncovered information on our jewel thief.
0.1: Her name is Olive, as you mentioned. She took my Job Advancement test to become a Bowman. I haven't the faintest idea why she'd do something like this. I want to speak to her in person.
0.2: She's in Ereve at the moment. Will you fetch her?
0.3: You should be able to find her at the #b#m130030006##k in Ereve. Just keep heading right once you reach Ereve to get there.

yes.0: You should be able to find her at the #b#m130030006##k in Ereve. Just keep heading right once you reach Ereve to get there.

no.0: Please, you're the only one who would recognize her.

1.0: I have to prove my innocence, before they cut off my head and feed it to the mushrooms!

npc.0: Olive's at the #bSmall Bridge#k to the east of Ereve. You must move quickly, before she catches wind of our chase!
